result.title: VisSearch-Bench: Evaluating Long Horizon Visual Search in Multimodal Agents
result.summary: Multimodal agents use web and image tools to answer questions beyond their internal knowledge. Some search tasks use images mainly to identify an initial entity, then rely on text retrieval. These tasks offer limited insight into how agents connect information across images, objects, and search steps. We therefore focus on visual context management. This involves organizing and using visual information and linking it to other findings during search. Visually intensive tasks require agents to combine object appearance, local details, or spatial relations with external information. We introduce VisSearch-Bench, with 204 human-written tasks across 7 main domains and 25 subdomains. It covers Set-wise Visual Search, Sequential Visual Search, Hybrid Wide-Deep Search, Competitive Visual Disambiguation, and Visual-Structure-Guided Search. Each task provides a reference answer, traceable evidence, and scoring rules. Accuracy measures complete task success, while Process Score measures the correctness and completeness of individual results and subquestion answers. Across 16 multimodal models, the best system fully solves only 26.47% of tasks, even with search tools. These results highlight the challenge of linking visual evidence with search results to produce complete answers.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 VisSearch-Bench，包含 204 个人工编写任务、7 大领域 25 个子领域，覆盖集合式、序列式、宽深混合、竞争消歧与结构引导五类视觉搜索；每项任务配有参考答案、可追溯证据与评分规则，用准确率与过程分评估 16 个多模态模型的视觉上下文管理与证据链接能力。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接诊断长程多步搜索中视觉细节、空间关系与外部信息如何被组织链接，与视觉证据筛选、获取证据与长程推理评价紧密相关；但其为工具调用型外部搜索基准，未触及内部 latent 状态，可供核查证据链接失败是否源自表示或使用不足。
